archive_policy.physical_archive_rule: Research and ablation artifacts are moved out of default operational report/model paths, while source scripts remain in place when they are imported by operating jobs.

A_OPERATING_CORE.meaning: daily pipeline core. Keep running unless return contribution weakens.

B_OBSERVATION.meaning: shadow observation. Keep payload visible, but review promotion by live return.

C_RESEARCH_ARCHIVE.meaning: research retained. Excluded from daily pipeline unless explicitly requested.

D_EXCLUDED_CANDIDATE.meaning: not deleted, but removed from default daily operation due weak return evidence or duplicate operational value.

AI-GROWTH-VALUATION-V01.reason: strategy overlay tests showed useful return tilt potential.

AI-DOWNSIDE-RISK-V01.reason: loss avoidance and risk tag are directly useful for strategy overlays.

AI-CANDIDATE-RANK-DELTA-V01.reason: candidate rerank/drop separation is directly applicable to S/T/I/C overlays.

E-ETF-V01.reason: ETF track is a separate strategic priority and mode-switch results show return lift.

AI-CANDIDATE-VALIDATION-V01.reason: candidate quality tags remain useful, but standalone return lift is not yet dramatic.

AI-THEME-PERSISTENCE-V01.reason: theme-level signal is useful as a supplement, but daily retraining priority is lower than core overlays.

AI-MODEL-SELECTION-V01.reason: interpretation value exists, but direct portfolio return contribution is not yet confirmed.

QM_FULL_FEATURE_SET_EXPERIMENTS.reason: broad feature sets add complexity and have not become champion features.

LOW_RETURN_AI_VARIANTS.reason: AUC or explanation-only variants without return improvement should not run in default operation.

DUPLICATE_SHADOW_TRACKERS.reason: trackers with overlapping purpose should be consolidated into current payloads.

DAILY_RESEARCH_ABLATIONS.reason: ablation jobs are development tools, not daily operation requirements.

pipeline_default_changes.reason: policy ablation is research validation; walk-forward and operational hardening remain in daily operation.
